subject: Ephemeral secrets stewardship and deploy-gate records request
messages:
From: audit-team@northbridge.com (Northbridge Security)
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: ephemeral secret custody + deploy gate records for SIG

Soojin —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of FinCo's SIG review we're asking for artifacts that demonstrate ephemeral secret stewardship over the last 90 days and the deploy-gate approvals that protect production deployments. Specifically we need:

- Short description of how ephemeral tokens are minted and revoked (who/what can mint)
- CI/CD pipeline evidence showing ephemeral token use (logs or masked snippets are fine)
- Audit trail for any vault access tied to deploy windows (CSV or query output)
- Change approval entries for the two production deploys on 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-03

Can you provide these as separate attachments or a single archive? ETA: EOD Mon 11/29 would be ideal for the SIG submission.

Thanks,
Anna Park
Senior Assessor — Northbridge Security
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: audit-team@northbridge.com (Northbridge Security)
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral secret custody + deploy gate records for SIG

Anna —

Thanks, we can deliver this. Initial plan below (I'll attach the artifacts to a single package and share the Drive link):

1) Ephemeral token flow (short write-up + Diagram) — how tokens are minted (CI service account -> short-lived cert via Vault, auto-rotate TTL)
2) Masked CI logs showing token minting and usage across the two requested deploys (we'll redact non-essential PII)
3) Vault access CSV filtered to the requested window (columns: timestamp, principal, action, object)
4) Change-approval records (ID + approver + timestamp + linked PR) for 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-03

Attachments (I'm including the runbook stub now, full package to follow): deploy_runbook.pdf (runbook excerpt with mint/revoke flow).

Jordan and Marissa are looping in the logs and approval exports. ETA: we'll aim to upload by 2026-11-29 EOD and will send a HubSpot record id once uploaded.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Controls Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T12:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral secret custody + deploy gate records for SIG

Adding the CI side notes here — deliverables we will include in the package:

- ci_pipeline_config.yaml (pipeline snippet showing vault auth step and short-lived token TTL) — attachment
- vault_access_log.csv (filtered, masked) — attachment
- log snippets from the runners showing token mint and revocation events (we will annotate lines with UTC timestamps)

A couple clarifications: the two deploys you called out (2026-09-18 and 2026-10-03) used the same gated workflow. The change-approval entries are in Jira and the PRs in GitHub; we will include the approval audit trail export and link to the PRs rather than full PR contents. If Northbridge requires the PR diffs, confirm and we can add them to the package.

-Jordan
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: audit-team@northbridge.com (Northbridge Security)
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral secret custody + deploy gate records for SIG

Thanks, Jordan/Soojin. Quick clarifications from the assessor: we prefer the approval log exports (Jira) as CSV and the PR links are fine — no need for diffs unless an assessor requests them later. For the masked logs we need three consecutive lines showing the mint event and immediate consumer call (timestamps aligned) to prove TTL enforcement.

Also please include the identity mapping between CI service accounts and the short-lived principals (who/which service can mint).

If you can confirm by EOD Monday that the upload will contain those items, we'll slot the SIG review prep on Tuesday morning.

-Anna
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: audit-team@northbridge.com (Northbridge Security)
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-26T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral secret custody + deploy gate records for SIG

Anna —

Confirming: package will include the CSV approval export, PR links, the masked CI log snippets with the three-line mint->call sequence, and the identity mapping table. We are uploading the artifacts to Drive now and will post the HubSpot record HS-789234 with access details.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q2wX-ephemeral-proof
Attachments in package: deploy_runbook.pdf, vault_access_log.csv, ci_pipeline_config.yaml

If Northbridge needs anything beyond this package during Tuesday's prep, ping me and we'll prioritize.

Regards,
